tagline: Robert Half provides specialized talent solutions and business consulting services, leveraging technology and AI to connect clients with qualified professionals.
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue is the primary indicator of business size and scope in the recruitment and consulting services sector. It reflects overall demand for the company's specialized talent solutions and consulting services.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company.
kpis.description: The company's revenue declined 7.2% in 2025 compared to the prior year, impacted by macroeconomic uncertainty.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Total profit after deduction of all expenses.
kpis.description: Net income fell 47.1% in 2025, reflecting economic headwinds.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in net income, underscoring sensitivity to economic conditions.

kpis.name: Diluted Earnings Per Share
kpis.description: Diluted EPS declined 45.5% in 2025, in line with the net income decline.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in earnings per share.

kpis.name: Unemployment Rate (United States)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of the labor force without employment.
kpis.description: U.S. unemployment rate was 4.4% in December 2025, up from 4.1% in December 2024.
kpis.signal: Slight increase in unemployment, indicating a less tight labor market.

kpis.name: Unemployment Rate for College-Educated Professionals
kpis.explanation: Percentage of college-educated professionals without employment.
kpis.description: The unemployment rate for college-educated professionals remained stable at 2.8%, indicating strong demand for specialized talent particularly in accounting, finance, and technology fields.
kpis.signal: Very low unemployment rate for qualified professionals, highlighting strong demand for talent solutions services.

kpis.name: GDP Growth (United States)
kpis.explanation: Annual growth rate of Gross Domestic Product.
kpis.description: U.S. GDP grew 4.4% in Q3 2025, versus 2.3% in 2024, reflecting an improvement in economic conditions.
kpis.signal: Significant acceleration in GDP growth, potentially positive for demand for consulting and talent solutions services.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $5.379 billion in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.133 billion in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: AI Investment
kpis.explanation: Ongoing investments in artificial intelligence technologies to improve recruitment tools and client experience.
kpis.description: Robert Half continues to invest in technology and innovation, including AI, to enhance client and candidate experience. The company is strengthening its AI tools for talent discovery, assessment, and selection, as well as for additional lead targeting.
kpis.signal: The company is investing in AI to enhance its talent discovery, assessment, and selection tools.

kpis.name: AI Solutions Deployment (Protiviti)
kpis.explanation: Systematic integration of AI across Protiviti's consulting service offerings.
kpis.description: Protiviti continues to invest in and deploy AI-based solutions by integrating AI into its existing service offerings while enhancing its own technology infrastructure and AI capabilities.
kpis.signal: Protiviti is integrating AI into its consulting services and strengthening its internal AI infrastructure.

risks.title: Global Economic Slowdown
risks.score_rationale: The risk is placed first in the 10-K and described as having direct impact on service demand. Language is strong ("severely reduce", "significantly decrease"). Context aggravated by persistent geopolitical tensions. High weighting for macro risks.

risks.title: Reputation Deterioration
risks.score_rationale: Noted as critical, tied to performance of placed employees and positions on social issues. Text emphasizes direct impact on revenue and stock price. Central position in document.

risks.title: Contradictory ESG Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Document details opposing regulatory pressures on ESG and DEI, with divergent laws in the U.S. and abroad. Alarmist language ("enhanced compliance risks", "legal uncertainty"). Regulatory category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Increased Competition and Automation
risks.score_rationale: Risk is repeated for both divisions (talent and Protiviti). Explicit mention of AI as disruptive threat. Concerned language ("no assurance", "low barriers to entry"). Combined technology and competitive category.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks Tied to Workforce
risks.score_rationale: Specific risks related to remote access via personal devices and cyberattacks enabled by temporary workers. Mention of contractual indemnification. Position repeated for talent and Protiviti.

risks.title: Dependence on Talent and Management
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes the company relies on human resources, not tangible assets. Succession risk for key executives. Strong language ("highly dependent", "failure to retain").

risks.title: International Operations Exposure
risks.score_rationale: Presence in multiple countries with political, regulatory, and currency risks. Explicit mention of conflicts in Ukraine and Middle East. Impact on revenues in case of strong dollar. Important position in document.

ai_positioning.summary: RHI does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, business segments, and company operations, with no reference to AI.
